svg.desc: Универсальный барограф с заливкой от нуля

rt:param.name: NoBounds
rt:param.comment: Не окрашивать показания при переходе через границы

rt:param.name: FillFromZero
rt:param.comment: Заливать вверх положительную область и вниз - отрицательную

rt:param.name: UseExternalBounds
rt:param.comment: Использовать пользовательские уставки из параметров привязки (только при NoBounds = False)

rt:param.name: val_HR
rt:param.comment: значение верхнего диапазона барографа (только для UseExternalBounds)

rt:param.name: val_LR
rt:param.comment: значение нижнего диапазона барографа (только для UseExternalBounds)

rt:param.name: val_HAB
rt:param.comment: значение верхней аварийной уставки (только для UseExternalBounds)

rt:param.name: val_HWB
rt:param.comment: значение верхней предупредительной уставки (только для UseExternalBounds)

rt:param.name: val_HTB
rt:param.comment: значение верхней технологической уставки (только для UseExternalBounds)

rt:param.name: val_LTB
rt:param.comment: значение нижней технологической уставки (только для UseExternalBounds)

rt:param.name: val_LWB
rt:param.comment: значение нижней предупредительной уставки (только для UseExternalBounds)

rt:param.name: val_LAB
rt:param.comment: значение нижней аварийной уставки (только для UseExternalBounds)

rt:var.name: AckSupport
rt:var.comment: Фиктивная переменная, означающая, что данный объект поддерживает самоквитирование по функции AckMe()

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub AckMe() If Allow_Confirm && Blink_on_NACK && flag_confirm && (In_Alarm > 0) && MyAlarm Then If pv.NotAcknowledged Then pv.AcknowledgeAlarm(0) End If AckThisBinPV(B_HIHI) AckThisBinPV(B_HI) AckThisBinPV(B_H) AckThisBinPV(B_L) AckThisBinPV(B_LO) AckThisBinPV(B_LOLO) ' AckThisBinPV(B_IMITATION) In_Alarm = False End If End Sub
Sub AckThisBinPV(ByVal curPV As PlsPVBin) If (curPV != Nothing) Then If curPV.NotAcknowledged Then curPV.AcknowledgeAlarm(0) End If End If End Sub

Sub ValCalc() Dim v As double Dim aux_size As Float If (pv == Nothing) || (Object_Type == 0) Then body.y = 0 body.height = ht Exit Sub ElseIf (val_R_HI == val_R_LO) Then body.y = 0 body.height = ht Else v = pv.Value If (v > val_R_HI) Then v = val_R_HI H_range_exceed.visibility = "visible" L_range_exceed.visibility = "hidden" ElseIf (v < val_R_LO) Then v = val_R_LO L_range_exceed.visibility = "visible" H_range_exceed.visibility = "hidden" Else H_range_exceed.visibility = "hidden" L_range_exceed.visibility = "hidden" End If If Object_Type == 1 Then If FillFromZero Then If (val_R_LO * val_R_HI < 0) Then If (v >= 0) Then body.y = (val_R_HI - v) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht body.height = v / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht Else body.y = val_R_HI / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht body.height = - v / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht End If ElseIf (val_R_HI < 0) Then body.y = 0 body.height = (val_R_HI - v) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht Else body.y = (val_R_HI - v) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht body.height = (v - val_R_LO) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht End If Else body.y = (val_R_HI - v) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht body.height = (v - val_R_LO) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht End If ElseIf Object_Type == 2 Then If val_R_LO > 0 Then //снизу вверх If v == 0 Then //защита от деления на ноль v = val_R_LO * 0.99 End If body.y = (Log(val_R_HI / v)) / (Log(val_R_HI / val_R_LO)) * ht body.height = (Log(v / val_R_LO)) / (Log(val_R_HI / val_R_LO)) * ht ElseIf val_R_HI < 0 Then //сверху вниз If v == 0 Then //защита от деления на ноль v = val_R_HI * 0.99 End If body.y = 0 body.height = Log(val_R_HI / v) / Log(val_R_HI / val_R_LO) * ht Else body.y = (val_R_HI - v) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht body.height = (v - val_R_LO) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht End If
Else body.y = 0 body.height = ht End If End If If NoBounds Then ValColor = Color_NB(pv) ElseIf UseExternalBounds Then v = pv.Value ValColor = Color_ANA_GOOD If Range_Error Then ValColor = Color_Inval ElseIf ((pv.SuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) > 0 ) Then ValColor = Color_Remont ElseIf (pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then ValColor = Color_Inval ElseIf (pv.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_LOCALOVERRIDE) Then ValColor = Color_Imitation ElseIf (v > val_R_HI) || (v < val_R_LO) Then ValColor = Color_Inval ElseIf (val_B_HIHI < val_R_HI) && (v > val_B_HIHI) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_HI_A ElseIf (val_B_LOLO > val_R_LO) && (v < val_B_LOLO) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_LO_A ElseIf (val_B_HI < val_R_HI) && (v > val_B_HI) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_HI_P ElseIf (val_B_LO > val_R_LO) && (v < val_B_LO) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_LO_P ElseIf (val_B_H < val_R_HI) && (v > val_B_H) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_HI_T ElseIf (val_B_L > val_R_LO) && (v < val_B_L) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_LO_T End If ElseIf FName Then ValColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv(pv) Else ValColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_XH(FKKS, Suffix) End If If (ValColor == Color_ANA_GOOD) && !In_Alarm Then ValColor = Middle_Color_Wieghted(ValColor, 0xcdcdcd, 0.5) End If End Sub

Sub Show_Bounds() If (pv != Nothing) Then If UseExternalBounds && !NoBounds Then val_R_HI = val_HR val_R_LO = val_LR Range_Error = (val_R_LO >= val_R_HI) If !Range_Error Then If (val_HAB == -9999) Then val_B_HIHI = val_R_HI + (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 Else val_B_HIHI = val_HAB End If If (val_HWB == -9999) Then val_B_HI = val_R_HI + (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 Else val_B_HI = val_HWB End If If (val_HTB == -9999) Then val_B_H = val_R_HI + (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 Else val_B_H = val_HTB End If If (val_LTB== -9999) Then val_B_L = val_R_LO - (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 Else val_B_L = val_LTB End If If (val_LWB== -9999) Then val_B_LO = val_R_LO - (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 Else val_B_LO = val_LWB End If If (val_LAB== -9999) Then val_B_LOLO = val_R_LO - (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 Else val_B_LOLO = val_LAB End If End If Else val_R_HI = pv.RangeHigh val_R_LO = pv.RangeLow Range_Error = CBool(val_R_LO >= val_R_HI)
If !Range_Error Then If pv.UseBoundsHigh(2) && !NoBounds Then val_B_HIHI = pv.BoundsHigh(2) Else val_B_HIHI = val_R_HI + (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 End If If pv.UseBoundsHigh(1) && !NoBounds Then val_B_HI = pv.BoundsHigh(1) Else val_B_HI = val_R_HI + (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 End If If pv.UseBoundsHigh(0) && !NoBounds Then val_B_H = pv.BoundsHigh(0) Else val_B_H = val_R_HI + (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 End If If pv.UseBoundsLow(0) && !NoBounds Then val_B_L = pv.BoundsLow(0) Else val_B_L = val_R_LO - (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 End If If pv.UseBoundsLow(1) && !NoBounds Then val_B_LO = pv.BoundsLow(1) Else val_B_LO = val_R_LO - (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 End If If pv.UseBoundsLow(2) && !NoBounds Then val_B_LOLO = pv.BoundsLow(2) Else val_B_LOLO = val_R_LO - (val_R_HI - val_R_LO)/100.0 End If End If End If End If
If (pv != Nothing) && !Range_Error Then If ((val_R_HI * val_R_LO) < 0) && FillFromZero Then line_null.visibility = "visible" NPos = val_R_HI / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht Else line_null.visibility = "hidden" NPos = 0 End if
If val_B_HIHI <= val_R_HI Then rect_hihi.visibility = "visible" HiHiPos = AutoPos(val_B_HIHI) Else rect_hihi.visibility = "hidden" HiHiPos = 0 End If If val_B_HI <= val_R_HI Then rect_hi.visibility = "visible" HiPos = AutoPos(val_B_HI) Else rect_hi.visibility = "hidden" HiPos = 0 End If If val_B_H <= val_R_HI Then rect_h.visibility = "visible" HPos = AutoPos(val_B_H) Else rect_h.visibility = "hidden" HPos = 0 End If If val_B_L >= val_R_LO Then rect_l.visibility = "visible" LPos = AutoPos(val_B_L) Else rect_l.visibility = "hidden" LPos = 0 End If If val_B_LO >= val_R_LO Then rect_lo.visibility = "visible" LoPos = AutoPos(val_B_LO) Else rect_lo.visibility = "hidden" LoPos = 0 End If If val_B_LOLO >= val_R_LO Then rect_lolo.visibility = "visible" LoLoPos = AutoPos(val_B_LOLO) Else rect_lolo.visibility = "hidden" LoLoPos = 0 End If Else body.y = 0 body.height = ht line_null.visibility = "hidden" rect_hihi.visibility = "hidden" rect_hi.visibility = "hidden" rect_h.visibility = "hidden" rect_l.visibility = "hidden" rect_lo.visibility = "hidden" rect_lolo.visibility = "hidden" End If ValCalc() DetectAlarms() End Sub

Sub DetectAlarms() If PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv.PVId, False) || UseExternalBounds || NoBounds Then In_Alarm = 0 Exit Sub End If If MyAlarm && pv.NotAcknowledged Then If pv.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = 1 //снятая неквитированная сигнализация Else In_Alarm = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация End If Else In_Alarm = 0 End If If FName Then Exit Sub End If If B_HIHI != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_HIHI.NotAcknowledged Then If B_HIHI.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_HI != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_HI.NotAcknowledged Then If B_HI.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_H != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_H.NotAcknowledged Then If B_H.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_L != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_L.NotAcknowledged Then If B_L.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_LO != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_LO.NotAcknowledged Then If B_LO.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If If B_LOLO != Nothing Then If MyAlarm && B_LOLO.NotAcknowledged Then If B_LOLO.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 End If End If End If End Sub

Sub CheckUsrGr() If UseExternalBounds || NoBounds Then MyAlarm = False ElseIf Alarms_ForUser Then //если надо распределять сигнализаци по пользователям MyAlarm = PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(pv.PVId, True) Else MyAlarm = True End If If !(FName || NoBounds) Then //уставки BIN есть только для привязки через KKS с границами If B_HIHI != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_HIHI.PVId, False) End If End If If B_HI != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_HI.PVId, False) End If End If If B_H != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_H.PVId, False) End If End If If B_L != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_L.PVId, False) End If End If If B_LO != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_LO.PVId, False) End If End If If B_LOLO != Nothing Then If Alarms_ForUser Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(B_LOLO.PVId, False) End If End If End If DetectAlarms() End Sub

Function AutoPos(ByVal LinVal As Double) As Float If (pv == Nothing) Then AutoPos = 0 //0 - это верх ElseIf (val_R_HI == val_R_LO) Then //защита от деления на ноль AutoPos = 0 ElseIf LinVal == 0 Then //защита от деления на ноль If val_R_LO > 0 Then //когда ноль снизу AutoPos = ht Else AutoPos = 0 End If ElseIf (Object_Type == 2) && (val_R_LO * val_R_HI > 0) Then If (LinVal <= val_R_LO) Then AutoPos = ht ElseIf (LinVal > val_R_HI) Then AutoPos = 0 ElseIf (val_R_LO > 0) Then //традиционный - снизу вверх AutoPos = (1 - (Log(LinVal / val_R_LO)) / (Log(val_R_HI / val_R_LO))) * ht ElseIf (val_R_HI < 0) Then //отрицательная область - сверху вниз AutoPos = Log(val_R_HI / LinVal) / Log(val_R_HI / val_R_LO) * ht Else AutoPos = -1 End If Else AutoPos = (val_R_HI - LinVal) / (val_R_HI - val_R_LO) * ht
End If End Function
rt:model.rt:event: ht = _This.height If FName Then Set pv = ANA(FKKS) Else Set pv = ANA(FKKS + "_" + Suffix) If !NoBounds && (pv != Nothing) Then Set B_IMITATION = GetImitationPV(pv.PVId) If (PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 1) == "Н.Д.") Then Set B_HIHI = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_HI_A) Set B_HI = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_HI_P) Set B_H = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_HI_T) Set B_L = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_LO_T) Set B_LO = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_LO_P) Set B_LOLO = BIN(FKKS + "_" + BIN_LO_A) Else Set B_HIHI = BIN(PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 6)) Set B_HI = BIN(PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 5)) Set B_H = BIN(PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 4)) Set B_L = BIN(PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 3)) Set B_LO = BIN(PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 2)) Set B_LOLO = BIN(PRJSPEC.GET_KKS (FKKS, 1)) End If End If End If ValColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK If UseExternalBounds && !NoBounds Then val_R_HI = val_HR val_R_LO = val_LR Else val_R_HI = pv.RangeHigh val_R_LO = pv.RangeLow End If Range_Error = (val_R_LO >= val_R_HI) 'Тип объекта 1-обычный; 2-логарифмический If (pv != Nothing) && !Range_Error Then If ShowLogScale && (val_R_HI * val_R_LO > 0) Then Object_Type = 2 Else Object_Type = 1 End If End If H_range_exceed.visibility = "hidden" CheckUsrGr()

rect.rt:event: Dim aux_cmd As String If (Object_Type == 2) && (pv != nothing) Then aux_cmd = "|" + CStr(pv.RoundDigits) Else aux_cmd = "|-1" End If If pv == nothing Then NoLink(FKKS) ElseIf Range_Error Then ShowWarning("Ошибка привязки границ.\nВерх = " + CStr(val_R_HI) + "\nНиз = " + CStr(val_R_LO), 5) ElseIf Object_Type == 0 Then ShowWarning("Ошибка определения типа.", 5) ElseIf NoBounds || UseExternalBounds Then Call_Win ("ws_ANA_NB", pv.PVId + aux_cmd) ElseIf FName Then Call_Win ("ws_ANA_FN", FKKS + aux_cmd) Else Call_Win ("ws_ANA", FKKS+"|"+Suffix + aux_cmd) End If

Dim aux_cmd As String If (Object_Type == 2) && (pv != nothing) Then aux_cmd = "|" + CStr(pv.RoundDigits) Else aux_cmd = "|-1" End If If pv == nothing Then NoLink(FKKS) ElseIf Range_Error Then ShowWarning("Ошибка привязки границ.\nВерх = " + CStr(val_R_HI) + "\nНиз = " + CStr(val_R_LO), 5) ElseIf Object_Type == 0 Then ShowWarning("Ошибка определения типа.", 5) ElseIf NoBounds || UseExternalBounds Then LoadPopUpMenu(pv.PVId + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_NB " + pv.PVId + aux_cmd) ElseIf FName Then LoadPopUpMenu(FKKS + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_FN " + FKKS + aux_cmd) Else LoadPopUpMenu(pv.PVId + "|ANAi|ws_ANA " + FKKS+"|"+Suffix + aux_cmd) End If
